---
name: Recommendation
about: Propose an idea, suggestion, or area for investigation
title: "[RECOMMENDATION] - "
labels: ["recommendation", "needs-discussion"]
---

<!-- 
  📖 Not sure if this is the right template? 
  See: https://github.com/peterkahumu/Cinestream/wiki/Issue-Selection-Guide
  
  Use this template when:
  ✅ You have an observation or idea that needs DISCUSSION first
  ✅ You're unsure of the root cause or best solution
  ✅ You want to flag an inconsistency or potential improvement
  ❌ You have a fully-defined feature request (use Enhancement)
  ❌ Something is clearly broken (use Bug Fix)
-->

### Area of Concern
<!-- What part of the application needs attention? -->

### Problem Statement
<!-- What inconsistency, inefficiency, or potential issue have you observed? -->

### Proposed Direction
<!-- What general approach do you suggest? (This doesn't need to be a fully-formed solution) -->

### Open Questions
<!-- What needs to be investigated before making a decision? -->
- [ ] Question 1
- [ ] Question 2
- [ ] Question 3

### Potential Impact
<!-- What would this change affect? -->
- **Scope:** [e.g., Entire app, Specific component, Visual only]
- **User Impact:** [e.g., All users, Mobile users only]
- **Effort Estimate:** [e.g., Small (hours), Medium (days), Large (weeks), Unknown]

### Risks / Trade-offs
<!-- Any concerns about this approach? -->

### Supporting Evidence
<!-- Screenshots, data, user feedback, competitor analysis -->

### Related Issues / PRs
<!-- Link to any related items -->

### Recommended Next Steps
<!-- What should happen next with this recommendation? -->
- [ ] Discuss in team meeting
- [ ] Create a spike/investigation ticket
- [ ] Gather user feedback
- [ ] Create detailed specs
- [ ] Proceed to implementation


### Complexity Assessment
<!-- Which category does this recommendation fall into? -->
- [ ] **Trivial:** Simple change with minimal impact
- [ ] **Small:** Localized change, well-defined scope
- [ ] **Medium:** Multiple components or moderate complexity
- [ ] **Large:** System-wide changes, multiple dependencies
- [ ] **Epic:** Major architectural changes, cross-cutting concerns

### Priority Assessment
<!-- How important is this recommendation? -->
- [ ] **P1 - Critical:** Must address for usability/stability
- [ ] **P2 - High:** Important, significant user impact
- [ ] **P3 - Medium:** Nice to have, moderate impact
- [ ] **P4 - Low:** Optional, minimal impact
- [ ] **P5 - Backlog:** Future consideration, low priority
